About Skydine

Dinner, turning slowly above the city

Perched on the 7th floor of STS Mall in Civic Center, Phase 4, Skydine is Bahria Town's revolving restaurant — a dining room that turns gently as you eat, so the view from your table is never the same twice. Over the course of a meal, the whole panorama of Bahria Town and Islamabad passes by your window.

It is a setting made for unhurried evenings: white-tablecloth fine dining, attentive service, and a kitchen that moves comfortably between three traditions — the spice and smoke of desi cooking, the wok-fired energy of Chinese favourites, and the polish of continental classics.

  • A full 360-degree panorama during your meal
  • Three kitchens in one — desi, Chinese and continental
  • Ideal for family dinners, celebrations and visiting guests
From the Kitchen

Three cuisines, one revolving table

Whether your table is in the mood for the comfort of home-style desi cooking, the brightness of Chinese wok cooking, or the polish of a continental kitchen, Skydine covers all three — so everyone at the table orders what they actually crave.

Desi

The heart of desi cooking is patience and spice — food built slowly, layered with whole spices, finished over open flame and charcoal smoke, and brought generously to the middle of the table. Deep, warming, familiar flavours that make a table go quiet for the first few bites.

Call for today's menu

Chinese

Cooking at full heat and full speed — the sear of the wok, glossy sauces, and the sweet, sour and savoury balance that defines the style. Bright, lively and made for sharing, it brings a completely different energy to the table.

Call for today's menu

Continental

Classic European-style cooking, carefully finished — gentle grilling, proper sauces and composed plates where every element earns its place. Refined comfort food that suits the fine-dining calm of the room.

Call for today's menu
